description: The Dapitan study joins utility records and a survey of 370 respondents in 17 barangays with EPANET simulations to compare intermittent supply schedules. This resource is provided by Baltazar et al.. Coverage is city as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-SA-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Reported schedule performance is simulated. The review did not establish operational adoption. For simulation, it documents an application that can inform scenario design. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
